name: swiftui-content-view
title: Content View (SwiftUI)
description: Full SwiftUI ContentTreeWire renderer covering all WireNode variants: inline runs (text/mention/hashtag/url/emoji/emphasis/strong/inline-code/link/soft+hard breaks), blocks (paragraph/heading/code/list/quote/rule/image), media, kind-dispatched event-ref embeds, and typed placeholders. Article-reading surfaces opt into text selection → highlight-creation, NIP-84 range overlays, and footnote markers + scroll-to navigation.
